verdict.rationale: Brex documents a REST transactions API that lists settled card transactions, plus an expenses API. Access uses dashboard-generated user tokens with selectable scopes, and the changelog references OAuth scopes such as `cost_centers.readonly`. However, the receipt evidence covers only upload and auto-match, not retrieval, and no expense-listing endpoint is quoted. Missing for 10: documented endpoints for listing expenses and downloading receipts, a full OAuth authorization-flow guide, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull transactions, expenses, and receipts through a documented REST API with OAuth and scoped tokens

citations.quote: This endpoint lists all settled transactions for all card accounts.
The transactions API lets you view your transactions, accounts, and statements.
The uri will be a pre-signed S3 URL allowing you to upload the receipt securely... we will try to match the receipt with existing expenses.
